## ✅ Ready to merge

This pull request is now ready to be merged:
- All CI checks have passed
- No merge conflicts
- No uncommitted changes

Reopen all closed pull requests, and remove such requirement from the system. No stale pull requests ever tracked, we always can continue working on all pull requests.

```
Triage PRs https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/36-https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/41, https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/49 and https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/57: close them, or rebase and run CI. Add a stale workflow (or equivalent) so PRs idle for more than 60 days are flagged and then closed.
```

That requirement went unnoticed by me, and it is completely wrong, and must be reverted. We never do any rebase or close of open pull requests just because long time has passed.

No stale pull requests policy can ever exist in our repositories.

Also in addition to JavaScript client side implementation, we should provide full JavaScript server/embedded implementation.

We need to ensure all changes are correct, consistent, validated, tested, documented, logged and fully meet each and all discussed requirements in deepest and widest possible sense (check issue description and all comments in issue and in pull request, make sure each and every requirement listed before actually checking if they were addressed). Nothing should be defered or delayed. The scope is the entire repository, every change in one place should also be applied in all places in the codebase and docs. Ensure all CI/CD checks pass.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
